designSystemScope: Per-template editable design system board for QRYON Labs, covering token roles, typography hierarchy, spacing, component anatomy, component states, section modules, placeholder behavior, responsive notes, package map, and source-hygiene guidance.

spacingTokens.sectionY: 96-140px vertical sections, tighter inside dark product bands

components: hero media placeholder and proof chips
button primary, secondary, dark, text link
pricing card and demo form CTA
proof metric card and testimonial card
image placeholder blocks and profile photo placeholder rules

componentAnatomy.navigation header: Logo, nav links, small status pill, primary CTA, responsive collapse guidance.
componentAnatomy.button: Primary oxide action, secondary outline, dark-band inverse, hover/active/focus/disabled states.
componentAnatomy.card: Surface, eyebrow, title, body, icon chip, optional metric, link action, border/elevation rules.
componentAnatomy.cta: Final conversion block with demo form entry point, proof strip, and footer closure.
componentAnatomy.placeholder: Editable text clue layers using image placeholder: [purpose] and profile photo placeholder: [role].
componentAnatomy.pricing: Three package tiers with buyer-fit labels, proof bullets, CTA, and enterprise option.
componentAnatomy.integration: Partner/tool row for cloud, research, security, and workflow signals.
componentAnatomy.workflow: Four-step deployment sequence with dark-band contrast and connective line.
componentAnatomy.proof: Metrics, reliability card, testimonial/research quote, security badges, and validation labels.
componentAnatomy.form: Demo/contact CTA pattern with field guidance for future Contact / Demo page extension.

patternModules: editorial quantum hero with central media placeholder
usageRules: Keep the ivory editorial base, oxide action, and cyan signal roles distinct.
Do not convert the template into a generic SaaS hero/cards/pricing layout; preserve the research/product rhythm.
Use placeholders as source-editable text clues unless final imagery is explicitly requested.
Dark bands should hold product preview, security, or conversion tension rather than decorative filler.
Extend future pages from the included source map and section modules.

surfaceEffectTokens.editorialCanvas: Warm ivory page base with subtle divider lines.
surfaceEffectTokens.quantumBand: Deep burgundy/graphite bands for product preview and final CTA.
surfaceEffectTokens.signalGlow: Small cyan/gold highlights used for data status, not large decorative blobs.
surfaceEffectTokens.raisedSurface: Warm elevated cards with thin border and soft shadow.
surfaceEffectTokens.researchGrid: Fine-line structural grid and circular orbit motif used sparingly.

placeholderRules: Use image placeholder: [purpose] for all website source image slots.
Use profile photo placeholder: [role] for testimonial or human image slots.
Do not embed generated imagery in editable source unless explicitly requested.
Make placeholder purpose specific, such as quantum control dashboard screenshot or research lab operator portrait.

sourceHygiene.autoLayoutReceipt: Homepage sections, nav, cards, CTAs, repeated rows, pricing, FAQ, footer, and design-system panels were built with Figma auto-layout. Manual positioning is limited to intentional decorative orbit/line/background accents.
